question: What will be the ending value of the ICE BofA US High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread for these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: Last FRED print 3.52 (Nov 19), up from 3.23 on Nov 13 and ~2.60 in late Aug, driven by Fed-hike repricing and an AI/chip equity rout; Nov 20 saw a further risk-off session (Nasdaq -2%, NVDA -7%), so the Nov 20 print likely lands ~3.55-3.65. Over the 11 trading days to Dec 4, the recent-regime random walk (daily SD ~7-8bp) gives an unconditional median ~3.58 with a fat right tail. Momentum and a December Fed hike argue for further widening; post-Thanksgiving seasonal tightening (Nov 2025: 3.19 to 2.88) argues for reversion. The upper bound of 3.745 is only ~22bp away, so ~27% escape mass. No Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market found.
